title: Man in Cap with Text Overlay
coreRelationships: The man's face is the dominant visual element, occupying the majority of the frame.
Shadows create a strong contrast across the man's face, emphasizing his features and adding depth.
The handwritten text on the left is visually dynamic, contrasting with the more static typeset text on the right.
The warm, muted color palette unifies the photographic subject and the overlaid text elements.
The cap partially obscures the man's forehead and eyes, adding an element of mystery.
